senses.gloss: अ॑-ह्वला f. not fluctuating, not stumbling, firmness, ŚBr.
the plant Semecarpus Anacardium, L.

आ-√ ह्वृ Ā. (Subj. 2. sg. आ॑-जुहूर्थास्, RV. vii, 1, 19) to make crooked;
to hurt, injure.
आ-ह्वर mfn. crooked, T.
आ-ह्वर—कन्थ n. N. of a town of the Uśīnaras, Kāś. on Pāṇ. ii, 4, 20.
आ-ह्वरक m. pl. N. of a school, TPrāt.
आ-ह्वारक m. pl. id., ib.
आ-ह्वृति mfn. crooked, cunning, Hariv.
आ-ह्वृति m. N. of a king, MBh.
आ-ह्व mfn. a caller, crier: (ifc.) named, called
आ-ह्वा f. a name, appellation, Suśr.
आ-ह्वय m. a lawsuit arising from a dispute about games with animals (as cock-fighting &c.), Mn. viii, 7
appellation, name (generally ifc., e.g. रामायणाह्वयं काव्यम्, &c.), MBh.; Ragh.; Suśr.; Kathās. &c.
आ-ह्वाय m. a summons
a name, L.
आ-ह्वयन n. appellation, name, R.
आ-ह्वयितव्य mfn. to be summoned or invited, MBh.
आ-ह्वान n. calling, invitation, a call or summons, MBh.; Pañcat.; Hit.
invocation of a deity, Mn.; MBh.
challenge, R.
legal summons, Mṛcch. Comm. on Yājñ.
an appellation, a name, L.
a particular calling in rites = 2. आ-हाव, q.v.
आ-ह्वान—दर्शन n. a day of trial.
आ-ह्वातृ m. a caller, summoner, Sāy.
आ-ह्वानन n. calling near, Nalac.
आह्वानय Nom. P. आह्वानयति, (in law) to summon Comm. on Yājñ.
आह्वायक m. a messenger, courier, MBh.
आह्वायिका f. a female messenger.
आ-ह्वाययितव्य mfn. to be called before a tribunal, Mṛcch.
